substantiveReview: Admitted act increments current sequence and clears prior focus. Only a connected actually focused origin creates intent; no extra HTTP, DTO, polling or capability change.

Current non-aborted page signal, permissions, sequence and enabled layout commit are required. Focusin to another element and window blur permanently discard intent; body focus caused by disable/removal does not.

Start result is captured only by the same intent and same operation. Native Pause ref is indexed by exact presented job object, with current accepted identity and state/update equality. File includes actor/acceptedAt/target revision; Package includes requestId/kind/acceptedAt. No invented DTO generation.
Refresh captures exactly the next original list/executor read sequence; a newer five-second poll supersedes intent. Initial reads and remount/reconciliation cannot manufacture focus.
Layout effects consume intent once and remove listeners; unmount removes listeners, original lifetime cleanup aborts requests. Existing Preview and saved-job per-action custody reconstruct exactly.

Four new File and six Package tests delay original response/body/list settlement, assert same accepted target, preserved moved-away/body focus, stale acceptance/remount refusal and polling supersession, and retain request/checkpoint counts.
Only one old expectation changes: explicitly focused manual Package Refresh now returns to that button; prior saved Job focus remains consumed. Other49 historical fixtures reconstruct exactly.
scope: Necessary correction of three preserved genuine focus failures; source clearance is not runtime qualification
